title: All API calls return CVX-2001 after upgrading to 2.0

posts.author: hlee
posts.body: Upgraded from 1.9 to 2.0 last night. The server starts fine, workers are running, but every API call from our scripts now returns `CVX-2001 missing or invalid authentication token`. The token hasn't changed and it's definitely in `auth.tokens`. What did 2.0 change?

posts.author: gwen_h
posts.body:
2.0 removed the `?token=` query-parameter auth. Your scripts are almost certainly still doing `curl "http://host:8577/api/v1/jobs?token=abc"`. You have to send it as a header now:

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer abc" http://host:8577/api/v1/jobs
```

That's the only auth change that causes a blanket 2001 right after upgrade.

posts.author: hlee
posts.body: That was it. Every script and our Grafana check used the query param. Migrated them all to the header. Thanks.
